notes.title: COSMOS Patch v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
Heres's the second small patch for Cosmos.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvements to Win Screen to help readability
[*] Slight improvements to the tutorial for controller players
[*] Added the option on controller to shoot when aiming
[*] The option to disable camera restrictions now follows the player horizontally
[/list]

notes.title: COSMOS Patch v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
Here's the first small patch for COSMOS, if you have any ideas, improvements or tweaks feel free to contact me! ːsteamhappyː

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Reset Button for Controller (Select Button)
[*] Added option to Disable Screenshake
[*] Added text in level select menu to Display your Overall Time once every level is completed
[*] Added option to disable limiting cameras vertical position
[/list]

notes.title: Try out the COSMOS Demo!
notes.notes:
COSMOS is a difficult action-platformer where you fight through fast-paced vertical levels with the use of wall running.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1252100/extras/Steam_Game_Festival_Trailer.gif?t=1592325093[/img]

[list]
[*] Conquer multiple worlds with unique enemies and levels to ascend.
[*] Tight-controls and fluid responsive movement with Wallrunning and Double Jumps.
[*] Handcrafted, short, difficult levels, idle for speedrunning
[/list]
